notes: Active models: Version 1 (trained on pediatric Kermany CXRs). Internal metrics are the pediatric test set; 'Performance by population' adds held-out adult test images; External Validation is an unseen hospital (Actualmed). A Version 2 trained with adult data was rejected because it did worse on the unseen hospital (source shortcut).

dataset.description: Pediatric (1–5 y) AP chest X-rays, single centre; re-split 70/15/15 grouped by patient.
